LtSurgeIntroText:
SURGE: Hey, you
little tyke!

I have to hand it
to you. It may not

be very smart to
challenge me, but it takes guts!

When it comes to
electric #MON, I'm number one!

I've never lost on
the battlefield.

I'll zap you just
like I did my enemies in war!
LtSurgeWinLossText:
SURGE: Arrrgh!
You are strong!

OK, kid. You get
THUNDERBADGE!
LtSurgeThunderBadgeText:
SURGE: THUNDER-
BADGE increases #MON's speed. 

Consider it proof
that you defeated

me. You wear it
proudly, hear?
LtSurgeFightDoneText:
SURGE: Hey, kid!
Still slugging and chugging away?

My #MON and I
are still at it!
GentlemanGregorySeenText:
You're here to
defeat LT.SURGE?

Not if I can help
it!
GentlemanGregoryBeatenText:
Sorry I failed
you, LT.SURGE, sir!
GentlemanGregoryAfterBattleText:
When I was still
in the army, LT.

SURGE saved my
life.
GuitaristVincentSeenText:
LT.SURGE recog-
nized my potential

with electric
#MON.

Think you can beat
me?
GuitaristVincentAfterBattleText:
If the GYM's traps
were working, you

would have been
toast…
JugglerHortonSeenText:
I'm going to take
you down! Prepare to be shocked!
JugglerHortonAfterBattleText:
Don't get too com-
fortable about

beating me…
LT.SURGE is tough.
VermilionGymGuideText:
Yo! CHAMP in
making!

You lucked out
this time.

LT.SURGE is very
cautious. He has

traps set all over
the GYM.

But--he-heh--the
traps aren't active right now.

You'll have no
problem getting to LT.SURGE.
VermilionGymGuideWinText:
Whew! That was an
electrifying bout!

It sure made me
nervous.
